priorityList: Cast Odyn's Fury as your top priority.
Use Recklessness and Avatar on cooldown, ideally together.
Cast Thunder Blast if you have 2 stacks of the Thunder Blast buff.
Cast Thunder Blast whenever Avatar is active.
Cast Thunder Clap if your Whirlwind cleave buff is missing to ensure your attacks hit multiple targets.
Cast Thunder Clap if Avatar is active and there are more than 6 enemies.
Cast Rampage if you are about to cap Rage (100+) or if your Enrage buff is about to expire.
Cast Bloodbath as a high priority strike.
Cast Rampage while Recklessness is active.
Cast Thunder Clap while Avatar is active.
Cast Execute on targets within health range or when Sudden Death procs.
Cast Thunder Clap as your primary filler for AoE damage and Whirlwind stacks.
Cast Crushing Blow or Raging Blow if no higher priority abilities are available.
